key_facts: CHECKED Sat Sep 5 (FINAL DAY T+1d to res=2026-09-06 / Sep 10-16 WHO window; Exa ECDC Sep 4 14:25, Outbreak News Today Sep 4, Africa CDC/Xinhua Sep 4 + local Sep 4-5 scan; UNCHANGED — North Kivu 0.46, Ituri 0.25, Haut-Uele 0.14, Tshopo 0.10, Bas-Uele 0.02; sum=0.97, outside=0.03): No new weekend DRC MOH/ECDC sitrep published on Saturday Sep 5 (ECDC updates weekdays only; next update Sep 7). Latest verified figures remain as of Sep 2: 6,342 confirmed cases and 3,072 deaths (48.4% CFR; 770 hospitalized, 1,475 recovered; 60/151 HZs across 6 provinces, 51 active HZs; +92 cases on Sep 2). Provincial standings: (1) NORTH KIVU (0.46): 913 cases (+25 Sep 2, +77 over 3 days = 31.8% of national new cases vs 14.4% cumulative share; 614 deaths = 67.3% CFR; 15/34 HZs) PLUS Reuters Sep 4 AFC/M23 rebel-held Kayna HZ case (from Butembo) ending >2 months Ebola-free status — clearest surge driver while Africa CDC notes a 2-week national plateau/decline; (2) ITURI (0.25): 5,164 cases (+60 Sep 2, 2,342 deaths, 28/36 HZs) with >1,000 red-zone schools reopened this week (8-10d incubation aligns with Sep 10-16 WHO window); (3) HAUT-UELE (0.14): 236 cases (+5 Sep 2, flat ~33/wk, 6/13 HZs); (4) TSHOPO (0.10): 22 cases (+2 Sep 2, wide scatter across 7/23 HZs including Kisangani); (5) BAS-UELE (0.02): flat at 4 cases (3/11 HZs). South Kivu 0 cases since May 29 (in 0.03 outside).
